results.note: BLS PPI news release (USDL 26-1687, 08:30 ET Fri 13 Nov 2026): the PPI for final demand rose 0.3 percent in October, seasonally adjusted.
Ukrinform (13 Nov 08:39 Kyiv) repeats the Air Force morning summary: from 18:00 on 12 Nov Russia attacked with 117 strike UAVs (incl. 63 jet-powered), below 170.
GUS flash estimate for Q3 2026 (stat.gov.pl, 13 Nov): real GDP not seasonally adjusted (constant average prices of the previous year) rose 3.5% y/y.
The ČNB record of the 5 Nov 2026 meeting on cnb.cz states four members voted for the decision (Michl, Kubíček, Procházka, Seidler) and three, Zamrazilová, Frait and Kubelková, voted for stable rates.
Finance Ministry Cenový věstník částka 124 dated 13 Nov 2026 (cap set 14:00) sets the maximum price of B7 diesel for 14–16 Nov 2026 at 45.38 CZK/l incl. VAT.

Ukrinform (13 Nov 06:27 Kyiv), citing its correspondent, reports Zelensky's statement following talks with Witkoff and Kushner in Dublin, i.e. an in-person meeting on 12 Nov, inside the window; the presidential office also posted a read-out of the discussion.

Kyiv Independent (13 Nov 20:40 UTC) reports Costa announced that leaders at the informal Dublin meeting agreed EU institutions together with the E5 (France, Germany, Italy, Poland, UK) will jointly represent Europe in the peace negotiations; consilium.europa.eu refused scripted reading.

ČT24/ČTK (13 Nov, updated in the afternoon) report that at Friday's sitting deputies sent the government refinery-tax bill to third reading, with the opposition tabling about thirty amendments, i.e. the second reading was concluded; psp.cz was unreachable.

ČTK's 13 Nov reports of Babiš in Dublin (Kbely departure on SAFE loans, Zelensky and Aliyev meetings, the Costa team outcome) and front pages of ČT24, Novinky and ČTK plus two targeted searches show no unambiguous 13 Nov statement that Czechia will not take part in new EU financing for Ukraine's 2027 needs; resolved from absence after about 45 hours.

ČTK (13 Nov, updated 20:30) says Babiš named Meloni, Tusk and Burnham as possible European negotiators already on Thursday 12 Nov, outside the window; no new naming on 13 Nov was found in ČTK, ČT24 or Novinky (his 14 Nov comment to ČTK named no person).

The only 13 Nov incident found is the IRGC claim of a gas carrier hitting a mine, which SAFETY4SEA (13 Nov) and gCaptain/Reuters (13 Nov) report from Iranian state media with no UKMTO confirmation; no UKMTO/JMIC report of a 13 Nov incident appears in gCaptain or the Google News UKMTO feed (ukmto.org refuses the reader), so resolved from two outlets before 72 hours.
Nvidia press release dated 12 Nov 2026 ('NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition') states Jensen Huang has resigned as President, CEO and board member effective immediately, with Colette Kress interim CEO.
UN Meetings Coverage SC/16508 (12 Nov 2026): the Council adopted resolution 2837 (2026), renewing the 2140 travel-ban and asset-freeze measures for 12 months.

Security Council Report's post-script says the Council unanimously adopted resolution 2837 on 12 Nov; UN Meetings Coverage records adoption 'by consensus' of the 15 members, with no abstention or vote against.

Vatican News (Holy See) puts the Pampas de Pimentel congregation at 'some 500,000 people', below 700,000; the figure appeared on 14 Nov 10:56 CET (04:56 Lima), after the window, while Andina's 13 Nov headline of 'more than a million' names no authority, so the Holy See figure was taken as deciding (interpreted).

Vatican News (Holy See) puts the Pimentel Mass at 'some 500,000 people'; Andina's 13 Nov 'más de un millón' headline cites no Peruvian authority, and the criterion gives the Holy See figure precedence, though it appeared only on 14 Nov (interpreted).

ČT24/ČTK (13 Nov, 15:23) on the second reading: 'Žádný koaliční návrh na rozšíření daně i na jiné sektory nezazněl'; the only windfall-tax extension came from two Green deputies of the opposition Pirate club.
ČTK (14 Nov, from the ODS spokesperson): Friday's presidium agreed on steps and more room for new faces, but Kupka named no specific people; no named personnel change was announced on 13 Nov.
ČTK (14 Nov): the ODS presidium on Friday did not agree to convene the extraordinary electoral congress requested by the Děčín branch.
